title: introduce-invocation-anchored-sampling-and-cost-fingerprint-metrics
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: Long-tail cost and latency issues are often visible only when traces are anchored to the original invocation boundary and correlated with callsite-level attributes. This PR introduces an invocation-anchored sampling layer plus a compact per-invocation cost-fingerprint metric that makes long-tail attribution and alert triage faster. Scope: 1) Add a sampling facility that pins sampled trace/context snapshots to the invocation root and preserves minimal KV warmup state so we can reproduce prefix-cost anomalies. 2) Introduce invocation.cost_fingerprint (compact string label) and invocation.cost_gauge (nanotoken-cost) to enable cheap rollup and histogramting without exploding cardinality. 3) New dashboard panels and a compact sparkline widget for callsite-level burst patterns. 4) Alert annotations: attach sampled invocation IDs to SLO/alert incidents for faster investigation. Checklist: - [x] design doc reviewed (ENG-1379) - [x] sampling layer implemented with bounded memory (configurable by tenant) - [x] cost_fingerprint generation + deterministic hashing - [x] telemetry: meters, histograms, and dimension caps - [x] dashboard and widget added to Observability -> Invocation Insights - [x] e2e integration tests + local replay bench. Backwards compatibility: sampling defaults to off for older clusters; metrics are additive and safe to query. Performance: sampling adds ~0.8% p99 latency for traced invocations (measured under T1000 synthetic workload); memory overhead is capped per-tenant. Rollout plan: staged rollout by region with tenant opt-in flag and a gradual global enable after 2 weeks of monitoring. Related: SUP-2241 (customer reported noisy long-tail alerts), ENG-1423 (follow-up work: correlate kv-cache-warmth with fingerprint).

Author (Ava): Added a 1-byte version prefix to the fingerprint and documented the migration. See runtime/metrics/cost_fingerprint.go.

Author (Ava): Exposed tenant.config.observability.sample_quota with sane defaults; added tests to validate enforcement.
Evelyn: Dashboard widgets look useful; request to add a link from SLO incidents to the sampled invocation view.

release_notes: Adds invocation-anchored sampling and a compact invocation.cost_fingerprint metric. New dashboard 'Invocation Insights' and alert annotations for faster triage. Sampling is opt-in by default; rollout gated by tenant flag.
